landed: frontend: 落位副本的 source/ 由 projectSources() 从该树 src/ 逐字节投影而来，副本里没有 src/i18n/index.ts，正与另五件 i18n 补丁所锚的 import 同层；这一件的 body 只写进用户配置目录下的副本，取件步于树内零字节写入。

export function wordFor(key: string, locale: Locale = LOCALES[0]): string {
  const row = WORDS[key as Word]
  if (row === undefined) {
    throw new Error(`i18n: no word is declared for \`${key}\``)
  }
  return row[locale] ?? row[LOCALES[0]]
}

export function useWord(): (key: string) => string {
  return (key: string) => wordFor(key)
}

description: The Chinese word table and the lookup every screen reads it through, written as a module the tree does not carry. The tree has no src/i18n/index.ts, so there is nothing to anchor against and the patch declares the file under `creates` with its path and its body; the take writes that body whole and refuses if the tree already carries the path. The other i18n patches anchor their `import` on openalgo-desktop/src/i18n/index.ts, so this module stands in the tree before the frontend build copies `src` as an input.
